gaps: The local Unihan_Readings.txt exact-character search yielded 得 kMandarin dé (line 621) and no row for 㝵. The official Unicode character-specific pages were attempted multiple times but inaccessible through the browser tool, so no official click-through page with either exact reading was inspected.

A modern Mandarin pair dé : dé is supported by local Unihan for 得 and by the Ministry of Education and CNS11643 sources for 㝵; the required official Unicode character page for 㝵 could not be verified. This modern pair does not establish an ancient phonetic relationship.

No same-system historical pair for 㝵 and 得 was verified. The local Baxter–Sagart table contains 得 *tˤək but no 㝵 row. Xiaoxuetang’s database homepage was inspected, but no exact character rows were retrieved; do not infer a component pronunciation from 得’s reconstruction.

The Ministry of Education entry transmits 多則切 for both graphs in Shuowen-related material, but that is a traditional fanqie statement, not a paired Old Chinese reconstruction. It supports the historical lexicographic phonetic analysis without quantifying the component-to-host sound match in a modern reconstruction system.
